tagline: Global payments and premium lifestyle brand powered by technology
hero_kpi_rationale: Billed Business is the primary revenue driver for American Express, as it directly fuels transaction fees and card revenues. It is the best indicator of the growth dynamics within its integrated network.

kpis.explanation_en: Total amount of purchases made by cardholders over a given period.
kpis.signal: Strong 8% growth in 2025, driven by consumer and corporate spending.
kpis.description: Billed Business increased by 8% in 2025, driven by higher member spending and expansion of the premium card portfolio.

kpis.explanation_en: Revenue generated from fees collected on each transaction made with an American Express card.
kpis.signal: Steady growth linked to overall transaction activity.
kpis.description: Discount revenue grew by 6% in 2025, driven by higher billed business volume, despite lower average fee rates.

kpis.explanation_en: Revenue from annual fees and other card-related fees, particularly on premium cards.
kpis.signal: Strong 18% growth, supported by high-end cards.
kpis.description: Net card fees increased significantly in 2025, due to growth in the premium card portfolio and higher average fees per card.

kpis.explanation_en: Average amount of fees collected per card in force over a year.
kpis.signal: Marked increase in unit revenue, indicating enhanced value perception of premium cards.
kpis.description: Average fee per card rose by 14% in 2025, reflecting product premiumization and demand for exclusive services.

kpis.explanation_en: Total number of active cards held by customers.
kpis.signal: Steady card base growth, indicating strong customer loyalty.
kpis.description: Cards-in-force increased by 4% in 2025, driven by net card acquisitions in both consumer and business segments.

kpis.explanation_en: Total value of transactions processed on the American Express network, including cards issued by partners.
kpis.signal: Sustained network traffic growth, despite increased competition.
kpis.description: Network volumes increased by 7% in 2025, driven by higher cross-border spending and strategic partnerships.

kpis.explanation_en: Amount set aside to cover potential losses on loans to cardholders.
kpis.signal: Credit risk stability despite persistent inflation.
kpis.description: Provision for credit losses increased slightly in 2025, due to moderate deterioration in macroeconomic outlook.

kpis.explanation_en: Measures American Express's total revenue after deductions for refunds and cancellations.
This is American Express's net profit: the money left after all expenses. It shows whether the company is profitable.
Measures loan profitability after funding costs. Indicates whether American Express earns effectively on its credit products.
Measures the percentage of loans written off as uncollectible. Indicates customer quality and financial health.
Measures the amount American Express returns to shareholders via dividends and share buybacks.
Dividend Per Share — total dividends paid divided by shares outstanding.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $1.77 in the latest year.
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.

kpis.explanation_en: Capital Return — total cash returned to shareholders (dividends + buybacks).
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $2.271 billion in the latest year.
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four fiscal years reported.

kpis.explanation_en: Payout Ratio — dividends paid divided by net income.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 21.0% in the latest year.
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.

ai_positioning.summary: American Express has no significant mentions of AI, machine learning, or artificial intelligence in the provided excerpts from its 10-K/20-F filings. The analysis focuses on financial data and loan classifications.

risks.title: Unfavorable macroeconomic conditions

The language intensity is high, emphasizing the potentially significant impact on customer behavior and profitability. (default score, to be refined)
